_README: Laundromat broker source registry. Mirrors the veterinary-scrapers/dental TDPM broker_codes.json pattern. site_prefix TLM = The Laundry Market (feeds thelaundrymarket.com). NEVER collides with TDPM-/TVM-/other verticals' siteId prefixes. 'ref_prefix' is the source-scoped broker reference shown muted on cards. 'aggregator: true' sources are treated like the network's other blocked aggregators and purged by the normalizer.
